notes: Japan-market page (nintendo.co.jp), model NTR-001(JPN). AXIS LABEL MAPPING: Nintendo JP lists 縦(tate, short/front-to-back axis) × 横(yoko, long/left-right axis) × 厚さ(thickness). Per SPEC 'height = long axis', so height=横148.7, width=縦84.7, depth=厚さ28.9 — i.e. Nintendo's own label for the long axis is 'width', the reverse of this registry's key. Dimensions are the folded (closed) state as Nintendo states 折りたたみ時; open-state dimensions are not published, left null. RESOLUTION ORDER: Nintendo writes '192×256ピクセル' (height×width); recorded here as [256,192] = [width,height]. active_area_mm IS DERIVED: 256 × 0.24 mm dot pitch = 61.44 mm; 192 × 0.24 mm = 46.08 mm, both inputs quoted from this same page. Cross-check: sqrt(61.44²+46.08²) = 76.80 mm = 3.02 in, matching Nintendo's stated 3インチ（対角）; the identical 61.44×46.08 figure is published verbatim by Nintendo as the 3DS bottom-screen active area, which validates the method. Panel is 半透過反射型TFTカラー液晶 (transflective TFT colour LCD) on the DS — note this differs from the DS Lite's 透過型 (transmissive). Both screens identical; bottom screen adds 抵抗膜方式 透明アナログタッチスクリーン (resistive analogue touchscreen). role primary=top screen, secondary=bottom/touch screen (registry convention, not Nintendo's). refresh_hz, materials, corner_radius, depth_at_hinge: not published by Nintendo, left null. hinge.axis='long' follows from the clamshell geometry (screens stacked across the short axis), not from a quoted line. controls[].position left null — Nintendo's spec text lists the controls but not their placement. ports: Nintendo lists a DS card slot, a Game Boy Advance cartridge slot and a stereo headphone/mic connector; only the headphone jack maps to the SPEC port enum (Nintendo does not state the 3.5 mm diameter), so the two cartridge slots are omitted from ports[] rather than mis-typed. released = Japan launch, quoted from Nintendo's own DS Lite news release; North American launch date not sourced from a Nintendo page, left out. announced: no Nintendo announcement release located, left null.
